facts.fact: 叙述者是一条名叫 Finn 的狗，主人叫 Kari；他通过 Kari 所谓的“后果”（consequences）学会规矩——忽视命令，下一个词就是 crate（关笼子）。
facts.anchor: He learned that himself through what his owner, Kari, liked to call consequences. If you ignored her command, the next word was crate.

facts.fact: Kari 的男友是邮差（mailman boyfriend），Finn 心里只叫他 pouch；对方则管 Finn 叫 pooch（小写）——Finn 认为彼此“扯平”（Even steven），并因为此人不断贬低他的 Kari 而拒绝给对方“大写字母的敬礼”。
facts.anchor: Kari was always rhyming on about what comes with consequences to her mailman boyfriend. Finn just thought of him as pouch.

facts.fact: Finn 能让 Kari 懂基本摇尾和“要出门”的叫，但无论怎么绕着跳、怎么警告叫，Kari 都没察觉 pouch 趁她不看时踢他、把手伸进她的钱包（Finn 知道那是“不许碰”的 leave-it）——人话狗话都不直达，他只能大量靠比划（mime）。
facts.anchor: Kari understood the basic tail wag or let-me-out bark, but no matter how he danced around or warning-barked, Kari never quite caught on that pouch kicked him when she wasn’t looking. That he snaked his hand into her purse, which Finn knew was a leave-it.

facts.fact: 像龙卷风一样，pouch 的时刻在昨晚（last night）到来：责骂声先起，吵醒了 Finn 但没吓着他——往常这男人只“fuck-you”一句就摔门走人，这次却是尖叫咒骂（词听不懂但如警笛般清楚），Kari 先发嘘声、再用平稳的“冷静下来”语气回应。
facts.anchor: Like a tornado, pouch’s moment came last night. The scolding started first. It woke Finn, but didn’t startle him. Kari sometimes made this kind of rhyme with this man who seemed such a slow learner. He generally just fuck-you’d and slammed the door. Instead, Finn heard pouch scream-cursing. Words unintelligible to Finn, but their siren-fire clear, while Kari first made shushing sounds, then went on in the even-toned calm-yourself-down voice.

facts.fact: 施暴升级：他的声音或拳头追着 Kari；“Bang bang! Bang bang!”啄木鸟般急促，有什么东西一下下撞在拖车裙板（trailer skirting）上；Finn 脊背上的毛竖起——危险醒了。
facts.anchor: The air snapped again and again as his voice or fists pursued Kari. Woodpecker-swift, the Bang bang! Bang bang! echoed when something struck the trailer skirting.

facts.fact: 门也加入了打斗——被猛拉开、又被推撞着关，最后整个脱落歪挂；今晨（this morning?）它靠仅剩的一只铰链在微风里吱呀，窗帘杆也斜靠着像 tipi pole。
facts.anchor: the door joined the fight—yanked open, then shoved shut until finally it came loose and hung askew.

facts.fact: Finn 发动了自己的“韵”——全速的爱带着他“脚与牙”直冲靶心（bullseye）；他记得跃起后摔作一团，不确定是否咬住了那个恶、把它扑倒到底（此前他还扑过窗想冲出去）。
facts.anchor: He had already launched his own rhyme. A full-throttle love that carried him—feet and fang—straight toward the bullseye.

facts.fact: 结尾 Finn 在等 Kari 那声确定的呼唤——她总在他睡觉蹬腿、梦中呜咽时笑着挠他说“醒醒，小家伙，你只是做梦”；他等着（He waited）。
facts.anchor: He waited now for the certainty of her voice.
